title: Corebridge Financial announces third quarter 2026 results
summary: Corebridge Financial, Inc. (NYSE: CRBG) today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
**1 min read | Published: November 2, 2026**


Corebridge Financial, Inc. (NYSE: CRBG) today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“Our third quarter results highlight the strength of our diversified business model, resilient earnings profile and disciplined approach to capital allocation," said Marc Costantini, President and Chief Executive Officer. "We delivered the strongest annuity sales of the year, continued to build momentum in advisory and brokerage, and increased operating earnings per share by 27%. These results reflect growing demand for retirement solutions, supported by our disciplined approach to risk, pricing and capital management, as well as our ongoing commitment to putting customers at the center of everything we do.”


Visit our[Investor Relations website](https://investors.corebridgefinancial.com/overview/default.aspx) for Corebridge earnings materials.
